TC-21/S07.title: Empty other context, both directions
TC-21/S07.detail: Local 25acd727, the runner gap (variants) closed by two specs with their own fresh accounts. Variant a (1 Hospital patient, 0 residents): NH -> Hospital -> NH; variant b (1 resident, 0 Hospital patients): NH -> Hospital -> NH -> Hospital. 8/8 judged: every switch to the empty context shows its empty state ('No residents on today's visit list.' / 'No patients on your list yet.') under the list heading, never a blank page and never the other context's patient; every switch to the full context lists its own row; NH All Residents is empty too ('No residents in the panel yet.'). No Clinic on any screen (recorded).
